summary: The Andersons, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that its wholly owned subsidiary Andersons Renewables, LLC entered a Merger and Equity Purchase Agreement dated November 3, 2026 with ECP V blocker entities, Harvestone Low Carbon Partners, LP (HLCP) and Heartland Merger Sub, LLC to acquire all outstanding HLCP limited partner interests for $915 million, via blocker purchases and merger of Merger Sub into HLCP, which survives as a wholly owned subsidiary. HLCP operates three low-carbon ethanol plants in North Dakota and Indiana with ~215 million gallons annual capacity. Financing combines long-term debt and revolver; committed letters from U.S. Bank and Farm Credit Mid-America. Expected close Q4 2026 or early Q1 2027, subject to regulatory approvals. Watch financing documentation and regulatory timing.
